checks.name: christoffel_count

checks.name: vielbein_postulate
checks.detail: d_mu e^a_nu - Gamma^l_mu,nu e^a_l + omega_mu^a_b e^b_nu = 0 for all 512 components

checks.name: omega_components
checks.detail: 12 independent nonzero omega_mu,ab (a < b in the order x0..x7): i = x1..x3: omega_i,(i)(x4) = a4' E^a4 Sin[z]^(1/6), omega_i,(x0)(i) = -H E^a4 Sin[z]^(1/6) (i.e. omega_i,(i)(x0) = H E^a4 Sin[z]^(1/6)); t = x5..x7: omega_t,(x4)(t) = -(a4' - b4'/(2 b4)) E^-a4 b4^(1/2) Sin[z]^(1/6), omega_t,(x0)(t) = H E^-a4 b4^(1/2) Sin[z]^(1/6) (i.e. omega_t,(t)(x0) = -H E^-a4 b4^(1/2) Sin[z]^(1/6)); omega_x0 = omega_x4 = 0

checks.name: gammaOmega_total
checks.detail: gamma^mu Omega_mu = 3 H gamma^(x0) + (3/4)(b4'/b4) gamma^(x4) (b4 = 1: 3 H gamma^(x0), field-theory.json)

checks.name: gammaOmega_per_direction
checks.detail: per direction (no sum): gamma^(xi) Omega_xi = (a4'/2) gamma^(x4) + (H/2) gamma^(x0) (i = 1, 2, 3); gamma^(xt) Omega_xt = (-a4'/2 + b4'/(4 b4)) gamma^(x4) + (H/2) gamma^(x0) (t = 5, 6, 7); the x4 terms no longer cancel: their sum is (3/4) b4'/b4

checks.name: gammaOmega_divergence_form
checks.detail: {gamma^mu, Omega_mu} = 0 for each mu, hence gamma^mu Omega_mu = (1/(2 sqrt g)) d_mu (sqrt g gamma^mu); with sqrt g = b4^(3/2) Cos z the x4 term is (3/4)(b4'/b4) gamma^(x4)
